representation: The existing SIMD table appends eleven unary/binary selectors after 211 existing selectors. Swizzle, truncation, extrema and Q15 project existing strict operations. One composition table derives ternary lowering: ordinary bitselect and four relaxed lane selections share bitselect; madd/nmadd compose optional first-operand negation, multiplication and addition with explicit unfused rounding; dot-add composes signed saturated byte-pair dot, signed pairwise extension and I32 addition. Consumed three operands remain reserved while allocating temporary registers. The distinct signed byte-pair dot rule saturates signed I16 sums, unlike ordinary signed I16-to-I32 wrapping dot. No new cells, opcodes, executor, identity map or residual format.
